arg.name: model
arg.description: TurtleBot3 model type: burger, waffle, or waffle_pi

arg.name: launch_client
arg.description: Whether to launch the action client alongside Gazebo and server

arg.name: target_x
arg.description: Target X coordinate for the action client

arg.name: target_y
arg.description: Target Y coordinate for the action client

arg.name: linear_velocity
arg.description: Target linear velocity (default 0.22 m/s for TurtleBot3 burger)

arg.name: cancel_after_sec
arg.description: Auto-cancellation delay in seconds (0.0 to disable)
